issues.title: Bring the status band up to date
issues.body:
The band says steps 3 and 4 are still running and a red issue is open. Every claim on the page is true on the day this merges: take each step's state and date, and whether a red issue is open, from `docs/status.md`.

Tests: every step is present with a state and a date, and the band agrees with `docs/status.md` as it was when the page was written.

Holds for every site issue: every claim on the page is true on the day this merges, using the facts in `docs/status.md`; it reads at 390 px and at 1440 px.

`index.html`, `tests/`
